name: VideoMaker_Bench
description: A benchmark for evaluating text-to-video generation/creation systems (VideoMaker workflows), measuring how well models turn textual prompts into short videos. Tasks typically require generating temporally coherent, visually plausible clips that align with textual instructions, and evaluations combine automated metrics and human judgments.
evaluation_method: human_eval (commonly supplemented with automated metrics such as FVD, FID, and CLIPScore)
reputation: Relatively new / niche dataset on Hugging Face with limited community adoption so far.
